v1.59.6a (3 April 2025) |feed_title = Baseplate |feed_color = Beige |previous_update = [[v1.58.0]] |next_update = [[v1.60.0]] }} ==Description== '''v1.59.0''' is the one hundred and tenth update to be released in Tower Defense Simulator, on the 1st of April 2025. It was the April Fools' Day update for 2025. This version contains nine updates, the main v1.59.0 (released 1 April 2025) and eigth minor updates, the v1.59.0a (released 1 April 2025), v1.59.1 (released 1 April 2025), v1.59.2 (released 1 April 2025), v1.59.3 (released 1 April 2025), v1.59.4 (released 1 April 2025), v1.59.5 (released 2 April 2025), v1.59.6 (released 2 April 2025) and v1.59.6a (released 3 April 2025). ==Additions== ===Crates=== *[[UglyCrate]] **Skin: ***[[Farm]]: {{Color|Ugly|PNG}} *[[Coin Crate]] **Skins: ***[[Jester]]: {{Color|CoinCrate|The Flea}}, {{Color|CoinCrate|The Beast}} ***[[Crook Boss]]: {{Color|CoinCrate|Alien Focus}} ===Maps=== *[[Baseplate-W]] *[[Baseplate-L]] ===Miscellaneous=== *[[April Fools 2025 Event]] *[[April fools 2025]] Modifier *Baseplate Lobby *Baseplate Map Statue *New [[Codes|Code]]: Enter Code Here **Gives one [[Coin Crate]]. :In '''v1.59.0a''': *New [[Codes|Code]]: EnterCodeHere **Gives one [[Coin Crate]]. ==Changes & Bugfixes== *[[Holiday Crate]] taken offsale. *Added pop-ups for when a player completes an achievement. *[[April fools 2025]] is now active on all maps. *Fixed ''[[Titles|tH3 GL1tcH]]'' being impossible to equip. *Fixed [[Executioner]] being giftable. :In '''v1.59.1''': *Lobby replaced with the regular lobby except it has a humanoid rat performing the [[Boston Breakdance]] that acts as a [[PVP]] ranked statue. Also makes all [[April Fools 2025 Event]] crates unobtainable. :In '''v1.59.2''': *Fixed the lobby not being the baseplate one. :In '''v1.59.3''': *Fixed [[DJ Booth]] being unable to buff towers, use its ability or play music. *Fixed {{Color|CoinCrate|Alien Focus}} [[Crook Boss]] not dealing damage or summoning units. *Fixed {{Color|Ugly|PNG}} [[Farm]] being impossible to place down. :In '''v1.59.4''': *Fixed [[Jester]] gifting not working correctly. :In '''v1.59.5''': *Reverted all lobby changes. *[[April fools 2025]] disabled from all maps, besides [[Baseplate-L]] and [[Baseplate-W]]. *Fixed returning to lobby not working correctly. :In '''v1.59.6''': *Removed [[Executioner]] and [[Jester]] from the [[Robux Shop]]. :In '''v1.59.6a''': *Updated the lobby for the new like requirement skin. ==Gallery== {{Gallery|Open = Yes| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} V1.59.0Render.png V1.58.0Thumbnail.png BruteThumbnail.png V1.49.0Thumbnail.png LemonadeStandThumbnail.png FirstPersonMinigunnerThumbnail.png RocketeerThumbnail.png PWIIThumbnail.png {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} TowrDefenceSimulater.png 1.54.0UpdateIcon.jpeg }} ==Official Update Log== ''NOTE: Not everything here will be accurate, as this is transcribed from the in-game update log.
